test_title: PYST 16: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 23 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: maths
question: The average marks obtained by a group of 11 students is 53 and the average marks obtained by another group of 13 students is 48 . What is the average marks obtained by all 24 students (approximately)?
solution:
**Given:**

Average marks of 11 students = 53

Average marks of 13 students = 48

Total number of students = 11 + 13 = 24

**Formula Used:**

Average marks of all students = (Sum of marks of group 1 + Sum of marks of group 2) / Total number of students

**Calculation:**

Sum of marks of group 1 = 53 × 11

⇒ 583

Sum of marks of group 2 = 48 × 13

⇒ 624

Total marks = 583 + 624

⇒ 1207

Average marks = 1207 ÷ 24

⇒ 50.29

**The average marks obtained by all 24 students is approximately 50.29.**
